system.description:
Using nature energy, you transform one of your arms into a jet booster like appendage that collects your Nature Energy, before you fire a beam of raw nature chakra. Make a ranged ninjutsu (or taijutsu) attack against a creature you can see in range dealing 3d10 force damage and forcing them to make a Constitution saving throw, being Bruised on a failure.

Amplify: By spending 2 Natural Energy as part of this jutsu’s casting, its range instead becomes a 30-foot cone originating from you. Compare your attack results vs the AC of all creatures in range, dealing damage to each creature on a hit.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3, the damage by 1d10. If cast at B-Rank or higher, increase the range of the jutsu to 90 feet, and if Amplified increase the Natural Energy cost to 4 and the size of the cone to 45 feet. If cast at S-Rank, if Amplified, when you score a critical hit with this jutsu, the affected creatures must make a Constitution saving throw, being Stunned on a failure.
